description.value: TG-07-04 (PS-ENT-04): de DeviceUseStatement van de eerste entry van sectie Medische hulpmiddelen conformeert aan http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/deviceUseStatement-eu-eps (wordt M op T2).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-13 (PS-TRM-02): elk Device.type in sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft minimaal één coding met system en code.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Device and (fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Device/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Device/' + resource.id)).intersect(%resource.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.device.reference).exists()).resource.all(type.coding.where(system.exists() and code.exists()).exists())

description.value: TG-07-14 (PS-TRM-03): elk Device.type in sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft een SNOMED CT-coding.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Device and (fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Device/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Device/' + resource.id)).intersect(%resource.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.device.reference).exists()).resource.all(type.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct').exists())

description.value: TG-07-15 (PS-TRM-04): elke coding van Device.type in sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft een display.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Device and (fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Device/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Device/' + resource.id)).intersect(%resource.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.device.reference).exists()).resource.all(type.coding.all(display.exists()))
